title: AsAntiIP
description: Protecting your server from IP spam.
body:
Developer: ItzAzeem
Discord: https://discord.gg/xRW5rdAvs5

------------------------------


AsAntiIP is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin designed to protect your server chat. 
It automatically detects and blocks IP addresses or server links posted by players, 
preventing advertising, spam, and unwanted promotions.

✨ Features:
- Blocks IPv4 addresses and server links in chat
- Customizable warning messages
- Permission node to bypass checks
- Lightweight and optimized for performance
- Easy to use, plug-and-play setup

🔒 Keep your community safe and your chat clean with AsAntiIP!
